lineWidth.description: Column width to wrap at when wrap is true. Falls back to the global lineWidth, then 80 if neither is set. Ignored when wrap is false.

indentWidth.description: Number of spaces per indentation level. Ignored when useTabs is true.

newLineKind.description: Line ending to use. auto keeps the input's existing ending, system matches the OS (CRLF on Windows, LF elsewhere). Overrides the global newLineKind; falls back to lf if neither is set.

useTabs.description: Indent with tabs instead of spaces.

align.description: Column to align field values at. false or 1 leaves a single space instead of aligning.

blankLines.description: Insert an empty line between each entry.

curly.description: Enclose all values in braces. Converts quoted values to braces.

numeric.description: Strip quotes and braces from numeric and month values (e.g. {1998} becomes 1998).

months.description: Convert month names to standard three-letter macros (jan, feb, etc).

sort.description: Sort entries by citation key (if true) or by the given field list. Prefix a field with '-' for descending.

duplicates.description: Check for duplicate entries by doi, key, abstract, or citation. true checks all four. If unset and merge is set, defaults to doi, citation, abstract.

merge.description: Merge duplicate entries using the given strategy (first, last, combine, overwrite). Turns on duplicate checking if it is not already enabled.

stripEnclosingBraces.description: If a value has double braces, remove the outer pair. {{Journal}} becomes {Journal}.

dropAllCaps.description: If a value is all caps, convert it to title case. Leaves Roman numerals unchanged.

escape.description: Escape special characters such as umlauts into LaTeX macros. true uses the legacy macro list; 'new' uses only package-independent escapes.

unescape.description: Convert LaTeX escapes to Unicode characters.

sortFields.description: Sort the fields within entries by the standard order (if true) or the given field list.

stripComments.description: Remove all comments from the BibTeX source.

trailingCommas.description: End the last field in each entry with a comma.

encodeUrls.description: Replace invalid URL characters with percent-encoded values.

removeEmptyFields.description: Remove fields that have an empty value.

removeDuplicateFields.description: Only allow one of each field in each entry.

generateKeys.description: Replace the citation key with a new key from a JabRef template pattern.

maxAuthors.description: Truncate the author list to the given number of names, appending 'and others'.

lowercase.description: Convert field names and entry types to lowercase.

enclosingBraces.description: Enclose the given fields in double braces so BibTeX preserves their case.

removeBraces.description: Remove curly braces within field values unless part of a LaTeX command.

wrap.description: Wrap long values at lineWidth (80 if unset) when true. No effect when false, the default.

omit.description: Remove the given fields from every entry.
